title: Trailer / Towing Prep
subtitle: Ratings, hitch, tires, cooling, lights, and tongue weight — a calm pre-tow so the trailer stays attached and cool.
tone: Production EN coach (US/EU): warm mentor, visual-first, max 2 CTAs, progress %, mileage personalization, legal disclaimer every step, high-risk modal with Find a nearby shop cancel, step feedback Yes/No. Phase 3 towing: ratings first; hitch/overheat = critical.

adaptive_rules.coach_note: Always use the lowest rating that applies to your exact engine, axle, and tow package — marketing tow numbers can mislead.
EV towing drains range fast — plan chargers, watch motor/temps, and stay inside the OEM tow rating.
Higher-mile tow vehicles: prioritize cooling system health and transmission service history before heavy loads.

risk_confirm.title: Hitch / coupler failure risk
risk_confirm.body: Improper hitch setup can release a trailer at speed. If the receiver, ball, or coupler is worn, cracked, or undersized, stop and find a nearby shop or hitch specialist.

risk_confirm.title: Overheat / transmission damage risk
risk_confirm.body: Towing with low coolant or a failing transmission cooler can destroy the powertrain. Never open a hot cooling system. If temps climb, stop and find a nearby shop.
